27•TARO Rak Lok Chok Deng Campaign: The Company partnered with 
Thai-Union Frozen Products, Thailand Post, and SLEEK EV to turn snack 
wrappers into Refuse -Derived Fuel (RDF) , reinforcing our Circular 
Economy efforts and supporting the 3Re Strategy toward lower 
carbon and cleaner energy.
•Award for Outstanding Human Rights Organization 2025 : The 
Company was recognized by the Department of Rights and Liberties 
Protection for its strong commitment to human rights, fair treatment, 
and non-discrimination , reinforcing our dedication to responsible and 
sustainable business practices.
ESG DEVELOPMENT
•Fuel for Cars, Milk for Hearts —Thais Never Leave One Another 
Project: The Company partnered with the Department of Internal 
Trade (DIT) to support local dairy farmers by distributing 360,000 
boxes of Thai UHT milk at 353 PT stations across six provinces. 
Customers received free milk with every qualifying refuel, promoting 
Thai milk consumption and improving community well -being 
through public –private synergy.
•PT Service Volunteer: Serving with Heart, Leaving with Smiles 
Activity: More than 400 executives and employee volunteers joined 
together to provide hands -on service at over 200 PT Oil and LPG 
stations across Bangkok and nearby areas. The activity aimed to 
deliver warm, fast, and friendly service while strengthening The 
Company ’s commitment to service excellence , enhancing 
customer satisfaction , and fostering empathy and volunteerism 
among employees.
